arabic: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا الزِّنَىٰ ۖ إِنَّهُ كَانَ فَاحِشَةً وَسَاءَ سَبِيلًا
transliteration: Wa la taqrabuz-zina, innahu kana fahishatan wa sa'a sabeela.
translation: And do not go near unlawful sexual intercourse (zina). Indeed, it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way.
reflectionLesson: Allah does not merely say 'do not commit zina', but 'do not even approach it'. Cutting off the digital triggers, peeking gaze, secret chatting, and late-night scrolling closes the doors before the sin takes hold.

arabic: قُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَغُضُّوا مِنْ أَبْصَارِهِمْ وَيَحْفَظُوا فُرُوجَهُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَزْكَىٰ لَهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ
transliteration: Qul lil-mu'mineena yaghuddoo min absarihim wa yahfadhoo furoojahum, dhalika azka lahum, innallaha khabeerum bima yasna'oon.
translation: Tell the believing men to lower their gaze and guard their private parts. That is purer for them. Indeed, Allah is Acquainted with what they do.
reflectionLesson: Guarding the gaze is the root of safeguarding chastity. When you avert your eyes from a forbidden screen or glance, Allah replaces the craving with the sweetness of faith in your chest.

arabic: وَتُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ جَمِيعًا أَيُّهَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
transliteration: Wa tooboo ilallahi jamee'an ayyuhal mu'minoona la'allakum tuflihoon.
translation: And turn to Allah in repentance, all of you, O believers, that you might succeed.
reflectionLesson: Allah addresses the believers directly: even after discussing modesty and mistakes, the door of Tawbah is flung wide open. True success (falah) is found in returning to Him repeatedly.

arabic: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ • إِلَّا عَلَىٰ أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ • فَمَنِ ابْتَغَىٰ وَرَاءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ
transliteration: Walladheena hum lifuroojihim hafizoon. Illa 'ala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fa-innahum ghayru maloomeen. Famani-btagha wara'a dhalika fa-ula'ika humul-'adoon.
translation: And they who guard their private parts, except from their spouses... but whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors.
reflectionLesson: One of the foundational traits of those who inherit Al-Firdaws (the highest level of Paradise) is preserving their sexual energy and honor exclusively within sacred bounds.

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ وَنَهَى النَّفْسَ عَنِ الْهَوَىٰ • فَإِنَّ الْجَنَّةَ هِيَ الْمَأْوَىٰ
transliteration: Wa amma man khafa maqama rabbihi wa nahan-nafsa 'anil-hawa, fa-innal jannata hiyal-ma'wa.
translation: But as for him who feared the standing before his Lord and prevented the soul from unlawful inclination, indeed, Paradise will be his refuge.
reflectionLesson: Every time an urge strikes and you tell your nafs 'no' out of awe and reverence for Allah, Paradise is actively being prepared as your eternal resting place.

arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّاهَا • وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّاهَا
transliteration: Qad aflaha man zakkaha, wa qad khaba man dassaha.
translation: He has succeeded who purifies it, and he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
reflectionLesson: After 11 consecutive divine oaths in Surah Ash-Shams, Allah makes the verdict: true victory in this life and the next belongs exclusively to those who discipline and cleanse their inner self.

arabic: وَمَا أُبَرِّئُ نَفْسِي ۚ إِنَّ النَّفْسَ لَأَمَّارَةٌ بِالسُّوءِ إِلَّا مَا رَحِمَ رَبِّي ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
transliteration: Wa ma ubarri'u nafsi, innan-nafsa la-ammaratum bis-soo'i illa ma rahima rabbi, inna rabbi ghafoorur-raheem.
translation: And I do not acquit myself. Indeed, the soul is a persistent enjoiner of evil, except those upon whom my Lord has mercy. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful.
reflectionLesson: Do not be surprised when your lower self demands temptation. Prophet Yusuf's story teaches that the raw nafs naturally prompts impulses; it is Allah's mercy and reliance on Him that elevates you above it.

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ كُلُوا مِمَّا فِي الْأَرْضِ حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ ۚ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
transliteration: Ya ayyuhan-nasu kuloo mimma fil-ardi halalan tayyiban wa la tattabi'oo khutuwātish-shaytani innahu lakum 'aduwwum mubeen.
translation: O mankind, eat from whatever is on earth that is lawful and good and do not follow the footsteps of Satan. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
reflectionLesson: Satan never begins by inviting you to major sin directly; he walks in subtle 'footsteps' — one curious click, one provocative reel, one innocent DM. Intercept the first step and you destroy his plot.

arabic: وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ نَزْغٌ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
transliteration: Wa imma yanzaghannaka minash-shaytani nazghun fasta'idh billahi, innahu samee'un 'aleem.
translation: And if an evil whisper from Satan tempts you, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is Hearing and Knowing.
reflectionLesson: When the whisper hits, do not negotiate with it. Say 'A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem' from the heart and physically put the screen face down.

arabic: أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
transliteration: Alam ya'lam bi-annallaha yara.
translation: Does he not know that Allah sees?
reflectionLesson: Even in an incognito tab behind locked bedroom doors in the pitch dark, the Creator of the heavens and earth sees every single pixel you look at and every heartbeat in your chest.

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ
transliteration: Ya ayyuhalladheena amanoo tooboo ilallahi tawbatan nasoohan 'asa rabbukum an yukaffira 'ankum sayyi'atikum wa yudkhilakum jannatin tajree min tahtihal anhar.
translation: O you who have believed, repent to Allah with sincere repentance. Perhaps your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow.
reflectionLesson: Sincere repentance consists of three pillars: immediately stopping the sin, deeply regretting it, and firmly resolving never to return. When you turn sincerely, Allah expiates the past completely.

arabic: وَأَنِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوا إِلَيْهِ يُمَتِّعْكُم مَّتَاعًا حَسَنًا إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى وَيُؤْتِ كُلَّ ذِي فَضْلٍ فَضْلَهُ
transliteration: Wa anis-taghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayhi yumatti'kum mata'an hasanan ila ajalim musamma wa yu'ti kulla dhee fadlin fadlah.
translation: And [saying], 'Seek forgiveness of your Lord and repent to Him, [and] He will let you enjoy a good provision for a specified term and give every doer of favor his favor.'
reflectionLesson: Repentance is not just about avoiding punishment; it invites barakah, mental peace, honor, and pure worldly satisfaction into your everyday life.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ التَّوَّابِينَ وَيُحِبُّ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
transliteration: Innallaha yuhibbut-tawwabeena wa yuhibbul-mutatahhireen.
translation: Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant and loves those who purify themselves.
reflectionLesson: Notice the Arabic word 'Tawwabeen' — it means those who constantly and repeatedly return in repentance every time they stumble. Allah does not expect perfection; He loves your persistent return.

arabic: إِنَّمَا التَّوْبَةُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لِلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ السُّوءَ بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ يَتُوبُونَ مِن قَرِيبٍ فَأُولَٰئِكَ يَتُوبُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
transliteration: Innamat-tawbatu 'alallahi lilladheena ya'maloonas-soo'a bijahalatin thumma yatooboona min qareebin fa-ula'ika yatoobullahu 'alayhim, wa kanallahu 'aleeman hakeema.
translation: Allah only accepts the repentance of those who do evil in ignorance and then repent soon after. It is those to whom Allah will turn in forgiveness, and Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
reflectionLesson: If you stumble, do not allow Satan to make you drown in guilt or prolong the slip. Repent immediately 'min qareeb' (soon after) while your heart is still soft.

arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ سُوءًا أَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهُ ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ يَجِدِ اللَّهَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
transliteration: Wa man ya'mal soo'an aw yazlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha ghafoorar-raheema.
translation: And whoever does evil or wrongs himself but afterwards seeks Allah's forgiveness will find Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
reflectionLesson: No matter how heavy your transgression or how ashamed you feel, the moment you whisper 'Astaghfirullah' with genuine sorrow, you find Allah waiting with forgiveness and mercy.

arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَأُولَٰئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ حَسَنَاتٍ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
transliteration: Illa man taba wa amana wa 'amila 'amalan salihan fa-ula'ika yubaddilullahu sayyi'atihim hasanatin, wa kanallahu ghafoorar-raheema.
translation: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allah will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
reflectionLesson: SubhanAllah! Not only does sincere repentance erase the record of shame, but Allah's supreme grace converts those past sins into good deeds (hasanat) on your scale.

arabic: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُوا فَاحِشَةً أَوْ ظَلَمُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ فَاسْتَغْفَرُوا لِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَن يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَلَمْ يُصِرُّوا عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلُوا وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Walladheena idha fa'aloo fahishatan aw zalamoo anfusahum dhakarullaha fastaghfaroo lidhunoobihim, wa man yaghfirudh-dhunooba illallah, wa lam yusirroo 'ala ma fa'aloo wa hum ya'lamoon.
translation: And those who, when they commit an immorality or wrong themselves, remember Allah and seek forgiveness for their sins — and who can forgive sins except Allah? — and who do not persist in what they have done while they know.
reflectionLesson: The hallmark of the Muttaqeen (the God-conscious) is that when they slip, remembrance of Allah jolts their conscience and they refuse to persist in disobedience.

arabic: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Qul ya 'ibadiyalladheena asrafoo 'ala anfusihim la taqnatoo min rahmatillahi, innallaha yaghfirudh-dhunooba jamee'a, innahu huwal-ghafoorur-raheem.
translation: Say, 'O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.'
reflectionLesson: Notice how Allah calls the sinners 'Ya 'Ibadi' (O My servants). Even in the depth of transgression, you belong to Him. Despair is from Shaytan; forgiveness is Allah's infinite promise.

arabic: وَرَحْمَتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ ۚ فَسَأَكْتُبُهَا لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَالَّذِينَ هُم بِآيَاتِنَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
transliteration: Wa rahmatee wasi'at kulla shay'in, fasa-aktubuha lilladheena yattaqoona wa yu'toonaz-zakata walladheena hum bi-ayatina yu'minoon.
translation: And My mercy encompasses all things. So I will decree it [especially] for those who fear Me and give zakah and those who believe in Our verses.
reflectionLesson: Your sins, urges, and weaknesses are finite; Allah's mercy is infinite. Whatever burden you carry, divine mercy is wider than all your mistakes combined.

arabic: نَبِّئْ عِبَادِي أَنِّي أَنَا الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Nabbi' 'ibadee annee anal-ghafoorur-raheem.
translation: Inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful.
reflectionLesson: A direct message from Allah to your heart through Prophet Muhammad ﷺ: never assume you are beyond redemption. He is Al-Ghafoor and Ar-Raheem.

arabic: كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ ۖ أَنَّهُ مَن عَمِلَ مِنكُمْ سُوءًا بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِن بَعْدِهِ وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَنَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
transliteration: Kataba rabbukum 'ala nafsihir-rahmata annahu man 'amila minkum soo'am bijahalatin thumma taba mim ba'dihi wa aslaha fa-annahu ghafoorur-raheem.
translation: Your Lord has prescribed upon Himself mercy: that any of you who does wrong out of ignorance and then repents after that and corrects himself — indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful.
reflectionLesson: Allah has obliged Himself with mercy for those who turn back and set their lives right. Pick yourself up, correct your habit, and walk forward with dignity.

arabic: يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ أَن يُخَفِّفَ عَنكُمْ ۚ وَخُلِقَ الْإِنسَانُ ضَعِيفًا
transliteration: Yureedullahu an yukhaffifa 'ankum, wa khuliqal-insanu da'eefa.
translation: Allah wants to lighten for you [your difficulties]; and man was created weak.
reflectionLesson: Allah acknowledges your innate biological vulnerability and weakness. His commandments are not designed to crush you, but to lift the heavy burdens off your shoulders.

arabic: وَلَا تَيْأَسُوا مِن رَّوْحِ اللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُ لَا يَيْأَسُ مِن رَّوْحِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْكَافِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa la tay'asoo mir-rawhillahi innahu la yay'asu mir-rawhillahi illal-qawmul-kafiroon.
translation: And despair not of relief from Allah. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allah except the disbelieving people.
reflectionLesson: Prophet Ya'qub spoke these words after decades of grief. No matter how deep your addiction or loneliness seems, divine relief (Rawh Allah) can change your life in a single morning.

arabic: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
transliteration: Fadhkuroonee adhkurkum washkuroo lee wa la takfuroon.
translation: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
themeLabel: Remember Me; I Will Remember You
reflectionLesson: Ponder this honor: the Lord of all creation promises that when you remember Him through dhikr, prayer, or holding back your gaze, He mentions you among the noble angels above.

arabic: الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ۗ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
transliteration: Alladheena amanoo wa tatma'innu quloobuhum bidhikrillahi, ala bidhikrillahi tatma'innul-quloob.
translation: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allah. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.
reflectionLesson: Addictive urges arise from a restless, dopamine-hungry heart seeking comfort in fleeting pixels. True calm, biological equilibrium, and peace enter only when the tongue is moist with dhikr.

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا • وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
transliteration: Ya ayyuhalladheena amanoo-dh-kurullaha dhikran katheera. Wa sabbihoohu bukratan wa aseela.
translation: O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance and glorify Him morning and evening.
reflectionLesson: Frequent dhikr morning and night builds an impenetrable spiritual armor against impulsive triggers. Replace mindless scrolling with SubhanAllah and Astaghfirullah.

arabic: إِنَّنِي أَنَا اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاعْبُدْنِي وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ لِذِكْرِي
transliteration: Innanee anallahu la ilaha illa ana fa'budnee wa aqimis-salata lidhikree.
translation: Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
reflectionLesson: Salah is the ultimate scheduled checkpoint in your day. When you pray with presence of heart, the urge to look at filth dissolves in the light of standing before Allah.

arabic: إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلَذِكْرُ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ
transliteration: Innas-salata tanha 'anil-fahsha'i wal-munkari, wa ladhikrullahi akbaru, wallahu ya'lamu ma tasna'oon.
translation: Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allah is greater. And Allah knows that which you do.
reflectionLesson: If you struggle with secret sins, examine your prayer. A sincere, mindful Salah actively acts as an internal firewall blocking fahsha' (indecency).

arabic: وَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
transliteration: Wadh-kurullaha katheeran la'allakum tuflihoon.
translation: ...and remember Allah much that you may succeed.
reflectionLesson: Victory in life, university, work, and spiritual purity is directly tied to how frequently your mind stays tethered to the Creator.

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
transliteration: Ya ayyuhalladheena amanoosta'eenoo bis-sabri was-salati, innallaha ma'as-sabireen.
translation: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
reflectionLesson: Sabr is not just waiting passively; it is the active endurance of holding yourself back from haram when the urge is screaming. Remember: Allah Himself is right beside you in that fight.

arabic: وَاسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ ۚ وَإِنَّهَا لَكَبِيرَةٌ إِلَّا عَلَى الْخَاشِعِينَ
transliteration: Wasta'eenoo bis-sabri was-salati wa innaha lakabeeratun illa 'alal-khashi'een.
translation: And seek help through patience and prayer, and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive.
reflectionLesson: When the dopamine urge feels overwhelming, perform wudhu, stand on the prayer rug, and pour your vulnerability out to the One who controls your heart.

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اصْبِرُوا وَصَابِرُوا وَرَابِطُوا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
transliteration: Ya ayyuhalladheena amanus-biroo wa sabiroo wa rabitoo wat-taqullaha la'allakum tuflihoon.
translation: O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may be successful.
reflectionLesson: The word 'Rabitoo' means to guard the border outposts of your soul. Your eyes, ears, and hands are the frontiers — station your taqwa at those gates.

arabic: وَالْعَصْرِ • إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لَفِي خُسْرٍ • إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ
transliteration: Wal-'asr. Innal-insana lafee khusr. Illalladheena amanoo wa 'amilus-salihati wa tawasaow bil-haqqi wa tawasaow bis-sabr.
translation: By time, indeed, mankind is in loss, except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
reflectionLesson: This is the essence of having an accountability partner: keeping each other steadfast upon truth and patient against sinful temptations before time runs out.

arabic: إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى الصَّابِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
transliteration: Innama yuwaffas-sabiroona ajrahum bighayri hisab.
translation: Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account [i.e., limit].
reflectionLesson: Every other good deed has a measured multiplier, but the reward for enduring hardship and restraining your nafs from forbidden desires is handed out by Allah without measure.

arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا • إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
transliteration: Fa-inna ma'al-'usri yusra. Inna ma'al-'usri yusra.
translation: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease. Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
reflectionLesson: Notice Allah uses 'Ma'a' (with), not 'Ba'da' (after). The ease is packaged inside the struggle. The first 15 minutes of an urge are the peak; survive those moments and the relief floods in.

arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ
transliteration: La yukallifullahu nafsan illa wus'aha, laha ma kasabat wa 'alayha maktasabat.
translation: Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned.
themeLabel: You Have the Strength to Overcome
reflectionLesson: Never believe the lie: 'I cannot control myself.' Allah certifies in this verse that whatever trial or urge you face, He has endowed your soul with the capacity to conquer it.

arabic: وَلَا تَهِنُوا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Wa la tahinoo wa la tahzanoo wa antumul-a'lawna in kuntum mu'mineen.
translation: So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers.
themeLabel: Do Not Weaken, Do Not Grieve
reflectionLesson: Lift your head up! A believer does not dwell in defeated depression. Shake off the shame, renew your niyyah, and rise up with high aspirations for Allah.

arabic: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمَعَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
transliteration: Walladheena jahadoo feena lanahdiyannahum subulana, wa innallaha lama'al-muhsineen.
translation: And those who strive for Us — We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good.
reflectionLesson: Jihad al-Nafs (the struggle against desires) is not in vain. If you fight sincerely for Allah's pleasure, He makes an explicit promise: He will illuminate pathways of victory for you.

arabic: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا • وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
transliteration: Wa man yattaqillaha yaj'al lahu makhraja, wa yarzuq-hu min haythu la yahtasib, wa man yatawakkal 'alallahi fahuwa hasbuh.
translation: And whoever fears Allah — He will make for him a way out and will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allah — then He is sufficient for him.
reflectionLesson: When you give up a forbidden lust for Allah, He creates an exit door from your darkest hole, provides halal love and barakah from places unimagined, and suffices your soul.

arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ ۖ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا لِي وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا بِي لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ
transliteration: Wa idha sa'alaka 'ibadee 'annee fa-innee qareeb, ujeebu da'watad-da'i idha da'an, falyastajeeboo lee wal-yu'minoo bee la'allahum yarshudoon.
translation: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the caller when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me and believe in Me that they may be guided.
reflectionLesson: You never need an intermediary to talk to Allah. In the exact second of your temptation or remorse, whisper your plea: 'Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum, protect my heart' — He is right there listening.
